title: All kinds of US-Zionist enemy assets are within reach
text:
All kinds of US-Zionist enemy assets are within reach"

"The military target database must be updated comprehensively to ensure that all kinds of physical and non-physical assets of the US-Zionist enemy are brought within the reach of the Armed Forces."

"From Imam Sayyid Mojtaba Khamenei's directive to senior commanders of the Armed Forces, Oct. 31, 2026
